subject: ArgentPay onramp: MAP & security anchors — SOC2/SIG/DPA timelines
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@argentpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ArgentPay Procurement <procurement@argentpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onramp MAP + security gating — quick context and ask

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — really helped the team understand Redwood’s routing and private deployment options. Our security committee asked for a concise mutual action plan that pulls together: (1) SOC 2 evidence / scope, (2) SIG/CAIQ mapping for payment workloads, (3) proposed DPA redline + retention schedule, and (4) an acceptance timeline we can present to the board.

Board window: final procurement decision by 2027-06-30. Can you share a MAP with acceptance criteria and an evidence handoff plan that targets closure before that date?

Specific asks:
- Can you confirm which SOC 2 controls Redwood can provide evidence for and the expected delivery dates for the report and attestations?
- For SIG/CAIQ, we’d like a CAIQ subset mapped to payment data flows (tokenization, PCI out-of-scope notes) — can you provide a lightweight scorecard?
- DPA: we’ll likely redline a few sections (data deletion, subprocessor list, breach notification SLA). We need a DocuSign-friendly DPA draft and a confirmation on retention windows/options (90 / 365 / custom).

We’ve attached our onboarding checklist to show dependencies (attachment: ArgentPay_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf).

Appreciate a proposed MAP by early next week if possible — we can sync on a 30-minute call.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Klein
CTO, ArgentPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@argentpay.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ArgentPay Procurement <procurement@argentpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp MAP + security gating — quick context and ask

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. I’ve drafted a MAP tailored to your board window and payment scope and attached two artifacts: MAP-ArgentPay-v1.xlsx (timeline + owners) and evidence_matrix_ARGP_v2.csv (mapping of Redwood artifacts to SOC 2 controls and SIG/CAIQ items).

Quick summary here:
- SOC 2: we can provide the 2026 Type II report for CC and Security categories immediately (attachment: redwood_soc2_report_2026.pdf). For controls requiring runtime logs (traceability / forensic), we’ve listed the evidence owners and an ETA of 6 business days for consolidated exports.
- SIG/CAIQ: I created a pragmatic subset we call "Payments CAIQ Lite" — it highlights 28 high-priority questions mapped to our infra and runtime controls. Jonas will add technical notes on the CAIQ mapping.
- DPA / retention: I proposed three retention tiers in the MAP (90 / 365 / indefinite) and flagged the rare-case escrow options. Kimberly in legal has suggested standard DPA language — she’s looped in for the redline.

Proposed next steps (in the MAP):
1) Evidence intake workshop — week of 2027-05-24 (Jonas / SRE / ArgentPay security)
2) Delivery of consolidated evidence bundle — target 2027-06-07
3) DPA signoff & procurement PO — target 2027-06-25
4) Prod access / PoC completion — target 2027-06-18 (we can reverse 3/4 if procurement prefers).

I’ve put tentative owner names in the MAP. Would you like a 30-minute intake on Monday 2027-05-24 at 10am PT?

Attachments: MAP-ArgentPay-v1.xlsx, evidence_matrix_ARGP_v2.csv, redwood_soc2_report_2026.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@argentpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ArgentPay Procurement <procurement@argentpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp MAP + security gating — SIG/CAIQ mapping notes

Sara / team — quick technical notes on the SIG/CAIQ mapping we attached:

- "Payments CAIQ Lite" approach: we prioritized SIG questions that directly affect tokenization, key management, and network egress (approx. 28 items). The full CAIQ (200+ items) creates noise for most payments customers; the subset is what our security reviewers commonly ask for.
- Evidence availability: items tied to runtime telemetry (e.g., request traces, KV cache access logs) are available via our Console export. Expect ~3 business days for curated exports after the intake workshop.
- PCI scope: Redwood’s hosted API is designed to keep card-present processing out of scope; we documented specifics in the CAIQ Lite notes.
- For any SIG questions that require a third-party attestation (e.g., HSM key custody by partner), we’ll include the vendor attestations and the timeline to get those (typically 5–7 business days).

I uploaded an internal mapping (Drive link included in MAP sheet) and flagged a few items for joint review during the intake workshop.

One operational ask: please confirm which environments you want evidence for (staging vs prod) — we recommend starting with staging to validate processes.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Security Architect — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@argentpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ArgentPay Procurement <procurement@argentpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp MAP + security gating — DPA / retention redline

Thanks all — looping to address DPA and retention notes. A couple of pragmatic recommendations so we can keep to the board timetable:

- DPA redline: we can accept a 90-day retention for ephemeral request logs and a 365-day default for aggregated telemetry; for PII-derived artifacts (that you expressly mark), we will support a custom retention term if required. I’ll prepare a DocuSign-ready DPA with tracked changes and include a subprocessor list.
- Incident SLA: propose 72-hour initial notification for incidents affecting availability/confidentiality and 24-hour escalation window for confirmed data exfiltration. This is negotiable but helps us align legal and engineering.
- KMS / key custody: we support customer-managed KMS for private deployments (we noted the steps in the MAP under deployment dependencies).

I’ll upload the DPA draft to the Drive and create a PowerForm link for signature. Expect the draft by 2027-05-27.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@argentpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: ArgentPay Procurement <procurement@argentpay.com>, Leo Martinez <leo.martinez@argentpay.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp MAP + security gating — confirmation and next steps

Thanks — the MAP and artifacts look good. We’re aligned on the staging-first evidence intake and the proposed retention tiers. A couple quick confirmations:

- Intake workshop: confirmed for Monday 2027-05-24 10am PT (we’ve added Jonas, Marissa, and ArgentPay SRE) — please send calendar invite and Drive link.
- Evidence handoff target: we accept 2027-06-07 for the consolidated bundle.
- PoC & prod access: we’d like PoC completion by 2027-06-18 and procurement signature by 2027-06-25. If you can get the DocuSign DPA into our lawyers by 2027-05-27 that would help.

I attached our PO for tracking (argentpay_procurement_po_1234.pdf). We’ll prepare any redline comments in parallel and surface them during the workshop.

Looking forward — Sara
Sara Klein
CTO, ArgentPay
